cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Everything Has Two Prices
cards.instruction: Price every offer twice: once in practical terms and again through an emotional cost that grows when the offer returns.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. You can borrow the dress for ten pounds and an acknowledgment that you mocked it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Money covers fabric. It doesn't cover wearing my bad taste proudly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Now say which part of my judgement improved since yesterday.
